rate_table_note: Rates are in RSMo 385.070.1(1)(a) and (b), printed in words. The statute attaches the joint $1.38 monthly rate to a "joint (two lives) level term credit life basis"; recorded as printed. A minimum premium of 75 cents is considered reasonable ((c)). History: L. 1977 H.B. 610 s. 13, A.L. 1983 S.B. 107, A.L. 1991 H.B. 385 merged with H.B. 575, A.L. 1992 S.B. 519; effective 28 Aug 1992. 20 CSR 600-2.110 applies these rates.
summary: Rates in force: Missouri's credit life rates presumed reasonable in RSMo 385.070: 55 cents (decreasing) and $1.10 (level) per $100 per annum single life, 92 cents per $1,000 monthly outstanding balance, and 90 cents per $100 per annum and $1.38 per $1,000 monthly for joint lives. Set by statute (effective August 28, 1992), so a change needs legislation.
